metadata.description: Claude Code plugin that wraps the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API (v1/sound-generation) — text → game-ready SFX with agent-decided duration, seamless looping, prompt-influence, variations, and WAV output with tier-aware format fallback.

plugins.name: eleven-sound
plugins.description: /eleven-sound:status, :config, :create, :trim — text → SFX via ElevenLabs. The create skill decides duration (0.5–30s or auto) and looping per sound type, writes realism-anchored prompts, and saves WAV (PCM) with automatic tier fallback to MP3.
